---
title: "combined_terminations"
output: html_document
params:
  output_dir: "output"
  as_of: null
---

```{r}
library(tidyverse)

if (is.null(params$output_dir) || is.null(params$as_of)) stop("output_dir and as_of are required")
as_of <- as_date(params$as_of)
if (is.na(as_of)) stop("as_of must be an ISO date")
start_date <- as_date("2025-02-28")
reporting_week <- floor_date(as_of, unit = "week", week_start = if_else(wday(start_date) == 1, 7, wday(start_date) - 1))
output_path <- function(...) file.path(params$output_dir, ...)
join_keys <- c("org_name", "org_city", "org_state", "week")
metric_names <- c(
  "current_loss", "current_grant_loss", "current_econ_loss", "current_job_loss",
  "overall_loss", "overall_grant_loss", "overall_econ_loss", "overall_job_loss"
)

assert_unique <- function(data, label) {
  duplicates <- data %>%
    count(across(all_of(join_keys)), name = "rows") %>%
    filter(rows > 1)
  if (nrow(duplicates) > 0) {
    stop(label, " contains duplicate institution/week identities: ",
         paste(head(duplicates$org_name, 5), collapse = ", "))
  }
}
```

```{r}
terminations_org_nsf <- read.csv(output_path("terminations_org_nsf.csv")) %>%
  mutate(week = as_date(week),
         lat = round(lat, 5),
         lon = round(lon, 5)) %>%
  filter(week <= reporting_week) %>%
  rename_with(~ paste0(.x, ".nsf"), all_of(metric_names))

terminations_org_nih <- read.csv(output_path("terminations_org.csv")) %>%
  mutate(week = as_date(week),
         lat = round(lat, 5),
         lon = round(lon, 5)) %>%
  filter(week <= reporting_week) %>%
  rename_with(~ paste0(.x, ".nih"), all_of(metric_names))

assert_unique(terminations_org_nih, "NIH organization output")
assert_unique(terminations_org_nsf, "NSF organization output")

terminations_org_combined <- full_join(
  terminations_org_nih,
  terminations_org_nsf,
  by = join_keys,
  suffix = c(".nih_location", ".nsf_location")
)

coordinate_conflicts <- terminations_org_combined %>%
  filter(!is.na(lat.nih_location), !is.na(lat.nsf_location),
         lat.nih_location != lat.nsf_location | lon.nih_location != lon.nsf_location)
if (nrow(coordinate_conflicts) > 0) {
  stop("NIH/NSF coordinate conflicts remain for: ",
       paste(unique(head(coordinate_conflicts$org_name, 5)), collapse = ", "))
}

agency_metrics <- c(paste0(metric_names, ".nih"), paste0(metric_names, ".nsf"))
terminations_org_combined <- terminations_org_combined %>%
  mutate(lat = coalesce(lat.nih_location, lat.nsf_location),
         lon = coalesce(lon.nih_location, lon.nsf_location),
         across(all_of(agency_metrics), ~ replace_na(.x, 0))) %>%
  select(-ends_with(".nih_location"), -ends_with(".nsf_location")) %>%
  mutate(current_loss.combined = current_loss.nih + current_loss.nsf,
         current_grant_loss.combined = current_grant_loss.nih + current_grant_loss.nsf,
         current_econ_loss.combined = current_econ_loss.nih + current_econ_loss.nsf,
         current_job_loss.combined = current_job_loss.nih + current_job_loss.nsf,
         overall_loss.combined = overall_loss.nih + overall_loss.nsf,
         overall_grant_loss.combined = overall_grant_loss.nih + overall_grant_loss.nsf,
         overall_econ_loss.combined = overall_econ_loss.nih + overall_econ_loss.nsf,
         overall_job_loss.combined = overall_job_loss.nih + overall_job_loss.nsf) %>%
  select(org_name, org_city, org_state, lat, lon, week,
         all_of(paste0(metric_names, ".nih")),
         all_of(paste0(metric_names, ".nsf")),
         all_of(paste0(metric_names, ".combined"))) %>%
  arrange(week, org_name, org_city, org_state)

assert_unique(terminations_org_combined, "Combined organization output")
write_csv(terminations_org_combined, output_path("terminations_org_combined.csv"))

terminations_org_combined %>%
  filter(week == reporting_week) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  summarise(across(starts_with("current"), ~ sum(.x))) %>%
  select(-starts_with("current_loss")) %>%
  write_csv(output_path("topline.csv"))
```
